First try a solid closed arrow: zero or more whitespace, two or more dashes, > or x, and zero or more whitespace. Next, two dashes with surrounding whitespace produce opening-arrow. Then surrounding whitespace and a dash, one or more dots, and a dash produce a closed reference arrow. Follows agentflow.md#arrows.
